instruction:
`get_introspection(model)` reports per-block living-layer state to Sanctuary. It is implemented in `luthi/generate.py` and re-exported by `luthi/sanctuary_interface.py`. Today it reads only v1-style fields (plasticity, set point, excitability, membrane, spikes, episodes), so on a v2 predictive-coding model (`PredictiveCodingLayer` FFNs) the v2-native signals are missing.

For each block, when the FFN has the corresponding attribute, also report:
- `error_acc_mean` and `error_acc_max`: the mean and max of `ffn.error_acc`, as Python floats.
- `pred_frob`: the Frobenius norm of `ffn.prediction`.
- `precision_mean`: the mean of `ffn.precision`.

Gate each on the attribute's presence, so v1 models (`LivingLayerV6`) don't get these keys and v2 models don't gain v1-only keys. Update the docstrings in both files to describe which fields appear for v1 and v2.

source.subject: get_introspection: expose v2 PC signals (error_acc, pred_frob, precision)
